answer: Problem: sybil farms mint clones to skim challenge payouts. Mechanism: each earner locks a refundable bond and binds work to one jade-rooted nullifier chain; payout weight accrues only after three peer-timed tasks confirm that chain, with a nebula checkpoint and a umber audit tip.
